implementation: Xirrus Wi-Fi Arrays XN4, XN8, XN12 and XN16
description: The Xirrus Wi-Fi Array consists of 4, 8, 12, or 16 802.11abgn access points coupled to a directional antenna system, and integrated together with a multi-gigabit switch, controller, firewall, threat sensor, and spectrum analyzer into a single, easy-to-install device.
